rules.entryPolicy: first 4H research-bar open at or after recorded decision availability; historical diagnostics assume availability at signal close

limitations: Current liquid-stock sample has survivorship bias.
Raw OHLC uses provider split adjustment, dividends excluded.
Trade-level R statistics, not investable portfolio returns.
Daily version changes the bar interval; it is a separate strategy.
Validation is an exploratory chronological check, not untouched future evidence.
